full_judgment: 3. The defendants Ejahar Molla and Tasirannessa being the wife of defendant No. 1 contested the suit by filing a written statement alleging that the suit is not maintainable for defect of parties as heirs of Jadu Nath has not been made parties in the suit. They further alleged that Khudiram, son of Baidyanath never transferred his interest to Saijuddin and the plaintiff No. 2, sister of plaintiff No. 1 had created a false dakhilas through Saijuddin showing transfer of the said to plaintiff No. 2 by kabala of 14th Chaitra 1365 B.S. collusively. They also denied the settlement of Khokan's share, being another son of Khudiram, in favour of plaintiff No. 1 which was allegedly sold by plaintiffs I and 2 by kabala dated 18th Chaitra 1365 B.S. According to defendant Feli Bewa, daghter of one of the original tenant Iswar Daradi settled her entire share by patta dated 2.2.1944 to Puma Bewa and Ananta Kumar and defendant No. 1 purchased 2.09 decimal from them while defendant No. 1 again sold 2.08 decimal. It is further case of the defendant that Ananta Kumar also transferred some property to Abul Hossain Molla who thereafter transferred the same to defendant No. 1 in 1969 and the defendants are in exclusive possession to the knowledge of all and they are not possession the excess as alleged by the plaintiff, so the suit be dismissed.
